name: week
title: Tenements this week
subtitle: What needs a person, worst first. Read-only. Changes are made by asking Claude Code.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select item, ref, project, owner, detail, due_on as due, days_left from attention_queue order by rank, due_on, ref

sections.title: Due in the next 30 days
sections.sql: select due_on as due, days_left, label as what, ref, project, manager as owner from open_dates where days_left between 0 and 30 order by due_on, ref

name: calendar
title: The tenement calendar
subtitle: Every open date for the next twelve months, with the rule behind it.

sections.title: Open dates
sections.sql: select due_on as due, days_left, label as what, ref, project, manager as owner, item as detail from open_dates where due_on <= current_date + 365 order by due_on, ref
sections.note: Form 5, rent, exemption, partial surrender and expiry dates come from each grant date and the rules table. Obligations come from your agreements and conditions.

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.sql: select severity, rule, ref, finding from compliance_findings order by case severity when 'breach' then 0 else 1 end, rule, ref

name: spend
title: Expenditure against commitment
subtitle: This tenement year, by tenement and project.

sections.title: By tenement
sections.sql: select ref, project, year_ends, days_left_in_year as days_left, commitment_cents, spent_this_year_cents, greatest(coalesce(commitment_cents, 0) - spent_this_year_cents, 0) as still_to_spend_cents from tenement_spend order by days_left_in_year, ref

sections.title: By project
sections.sql: select coalesce(project, '(none)') as project, count(*)::int as tenements, sum(coalesce(commitment_cents, 0))::bigint as commitment_cents, sum(spent_this_year_cents)::bigint as spent_cents from tenement_spend group by project order by project

sections.title: Last year's shortfalls
sections.sql: select s.ref, s.year_started as year_ended, s.commitment_cents, s.spent_last_year_cents as spent_cents, x.lodged_on as exemption_lodged, x.outcome from tenement_spend s left join exemptions x on x.tenement_id = s.id and x.year_ending = s.year_started where s.last_year_started is not null and coalesce(s.commitment_cents, 0) > s.spent_last_year_cents order by s.ref
